text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager alert: KV cache miss rate and continuous-batcher error rate spiked for prod-region-us-east-1 at 2026-03-15T02:14:27Z. Trigger: 5xx on /v1/generate (tool_calling routes).

sophia (oncall): seeing huge tail latency and 502s. paging to runtime oncall. marking customer-impacting? :eyes:

raj - runtime: on it. I’m seeing batch processing errors where a single request with structured tool call output (json blocks) causes the batcher to fail and evict kv cache for that shard.

marta - infra: can you share metric links? CPU/GPU spikes?

raj - runtime: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/kvcache?orgId=1 (link). miss_rate jumped 12x, avg latency +300ms, tail > 2s. also saw one OOM in runtime logs.

nina (SRE): @sophia, @raj, paging handoff to nina in 10m if not resolved. Please confirm owner.

alex - support: we have 3 enterprise customers reporting elevated 502s on tool-calling endpoints. CS alerted.

raj - runtime: initial correlation: requests containing function/tool-calling structured outputs (json arrays + tool metadata) break the continuous-batcher grouping key calculation. That causes batcher to treat cache keys as unique each token -> cache blowup and eviction storms.

sophia (oncall): propose immediate mitigation: 1) disable continuous batching for routes flagged as tool_calling 2) reduce batch_size to 4 for affected shards 3) disable prefix caching for structured-output responses. Which can we do fastest?

marta - infra: we can push a config hotfix to runtime-config service. ETA ~6m if low-risk. If deploy-bot ok, we can roll to prod shards.

raj - runtime: I can prepare runtime-config diff. prefer toggle over code change. Quick patch: set route.behavior.continuous_batching=false for matching routes and set route.cache.prefix_enabled=false for those routes.

sophia (oncall): go for it. I'm going to page nina for handoff window in case we need escalation.

raj - runtime: preparing patch now. patch snippet:```yaml
- match: "/v1/generate"
  predicates:
    - header: "x-route-type: tool_calling"
  behavior:
    continuous_batching: false
    batch_size: 4
    cache:
      prefix_enabled: false
```

raj - runtime: applying to config service (canary -> 10% -> 100%).

deploy-bot: config:runtime updated by raj - runtime. canary rollout started. rollout_id=cfg-20260315-0897

marta - infra: watching infra metrics. pre-canary CPU on shard-a was 78%, now 63% on canary nodes.

sophia (oncall): nina, handing off - will keep monitoring for 20m then escalate to oncall lead if persists.

nina (SRE): taking over. timeline?

sophia (oncall): canary started at 1761234685. early signs: miss_rate down 60% on canary.

raj - runtime: increasing canary to 50%. also adding temporary rule to skip cache insertion when response contains tool_call metadata:```diff
+ if response.metadata.contains("tool_call"):
+     skip_cache_insert = true
```

alex - support: CS sent interim status to customers: "We are rolling a mitigation that reduces errors; we'll update in 30 minutes."

deploy-bot: rollout cfg-20260315-0897 at 50% complete. no deploy errors reported.

nina (SRE): observed one more 502 on shard-b at 1761234810, correlating to large tool_call payload (~12KB). appears to be an outlier.

raj - runtime: bumping canary to 100%. applying second rule to runtime: treat tool_call responses as opaque for batching (batch_size=1). That avoids group-level parsing causing batcher exception.

marta - infra: config now at 100% across prod. monitoring for evictions and kv size.

sophia (oncall): metrics update: global miss_rate back to baseline in 8m. latency returning to normal. customer 502 reports down to zero after hotfix. :tada:

nina (SRE): still seeing increased disk IO during cache eviction window; adding temporary autoscale for cache nodes to reduce pressure.

raj - runtime: logs show the exact exception: "BatchKeyMismatchError: serialized-structure-length-change" when structured output present. filing runtime issue with stack trace.

sophia (oncall): good. action items for post-incident: - regression test for tool_call structured outputs in continuous-batcher - safer fallback when parsing fails - add telemetry: count of skip_cache_insert events - upgrade unit tests for batch key generation

alex - support: forwarding customers the summary and ETA for permanent fix. one customer requested rollback window — we gave them timeframe for patching.

marta - infra: rolling back autoscale for cache nodes after load subsides.

raj - runtime: created issue INF-4123 with reproducer and proposed long-term fix: normalize structured outputs before key calc and add size cap for batch grouping. owner: raj.

nina (SRE): closing pager for now but keeping incident channel open for 1hr post-mortem notes.

deploy-bot: rollout cfg-20260315-0897 completed successfully.

sophia (oncall): final status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: Sev2 (customer-facing but hotfixed). owners: raj (runtime) for fix, nina (SRE) for follow-up, alex (support) for customer comms.

raj - runtime: will open PR with unit tests + normalized key logic. target: 72h.

alex - support: will send customers a short incident summary later today.

sophia (oncall): thanks all. leave any logs or anomalous traces here. I'll compile timeline and hand to postmortem owner. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident channel will remain open for 60 minutes for final notes.
